title: Feature Engineered Reinforcement Learning for S-pair Selection in Buchberger's Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2611.34088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selecting the order in which to process S-pairs is a crucial decision in Buchberger's algorithm for computing Groebner bases: this choice can change the cost by orders of magnitude. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning agents viewing exponent vectors of the polynomials outperform classical heuristics on binomial ideals. We extend this line of work to general polynomial ideals by using statistical features. We introduce a 17-dimensional feature vector to describe a polynomial and use PPO to train policies on five distributions of random ideals. We find that using S-polynomial features significantly outperforms S-pair features on all five distributions. The new policies also outperform the retrained RL baseline on all five distributions, reducing algorithmic work by 41--53\% relative to the degree heuristic on four distributions where learning helps. translated_title: 布赫伯格算法中基于特征工程的强化学习S-对选择方法
translated_abstract: 在布赫伯格算法中计算格罗布纳基时，选择处理S-对的顺序是一个至关重要的决策：这一选择可能使计算成本改变几个数量级。最近的研究表明，观察多项式指数向量的强化学习智能体在二项式理想上优于经典启发式方法。我们通过使用统计特征将这一研究方向扩展到一般多项式理想。我们引入了一个17维的特征向量来描述多项式，并使用PPO算法在五种随机理想分布上训练策略。我们发现，在所有五种分布上，使用S-多项式特征都显著优于S-对特征。新策略在所有五种分布上也优于重新训练的强化学习基线，在学习有效的四种分布上，相对于度数启发式方法减少了41–53%的算法工作量。特征工程带来的额外开销意味着实际运行时间的成本……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出用17维统计特征向量描述多项式，将强化学习方法从二项式理想扩展到一般多项式理想的S-对选择，在所有测试分布上显著优于基线方法，相比度数启发式减少了41–53%的算法工作量。
